industry: Maize & Soya Aggregation / Commercial Feed Supply

facility_request.facility_type: Revolving Seasonal Commodity Working Capital Line
facility_request.collateral: Warehouse receipts on graded white/yellow maize (1.35x coverage) + assignment of poultry off-taker receivables
facility_request.purpose: Direct harvest-gate procurement of 1,400 MT maize from smallholder farmer cooperatives to fulfill institutional off-take contracts

qualitative_notes.business_overview: Regional grain aggregator sourcing maize from 420+ smallholder farmers across Bono East and Ashanti regions for commercial poultry feed mills and food processors.
strengths: Signed 12-month forward off-take agreements covering 70% of projected volume with two Tier-1 poultry producers.
Direct farm-gate procurement network reduces middleman leakage and ensures moisture-tested quality (<13%).
risks: Gross margin compressed 200 bps (from 21.0% to 19.0%) due to farm-gate price competition and transport fuel inflation.
Top two off-takers account for 58% of accounts receivable; delays in buyer settlement directly tighten working capital liquidity (Current Ratio at 1.27x vs 1.30x policy floor).
Post-harvest moisture and weevil spoilage risk if warehouse aeration protocols lapse.
qualitative_notes.management_experience: Founder has 11 years in agricultural commodity finance and supplier settlement operations; audited local financial statements for FY24-FY26.
